# Upstream provenance

`ThisFirmwareDoesNotExist/` is an unmodified snapshot of all 70 tracked files from
[ThisFreakDoesntExist/ThisFirmwareDoesNotExist](https://github.com/ThisFreakDoesntExist/ThisFirmwareDoesNotExist),
commit `083b15cabde98fc31eb89b40562aeeea38224968` (`freakpatch` 0.3.0).
It was copied from the local checkout requested by the user on 2026-10-23.
The source checkout was not modified; its `.git` directory and untracked files
were not copied.

The snapshot includes the original MIT license, patch sources, build tools,
generated original patch code, tests, and research documentation. It contains no
Arturia firmware. Copyright and credits remain with the upstream contributors,
including project handle ThisFreakDoesntExist and the upstream Claude Code credit.

FREAKOS reuses the upstream parser, exact input hash gate, patch application, and
output verification without weakening their checks. New project behavior lives
outside this directory. Upstream hardware results are attributed evidence, not
hardware verification performed by this project.

For an update, select an explicit upstream revision, inspect its changes, replace
the snapshot, retain attribution, and rerun baseline reproduction, upstream tests,
and local checks. Record the revision and resulting baseline hash here and in the
development log. Do not vendor firmware inputs or upstream worktree changes.
